name: Thunderous Smite
casting_time: 1 bonus action, which you take immediately after hitting a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike
description: The triggering melee hit deals an extra 2d6 Thunder damage and can be heard 300 feet away. A creature hit must make a Strength save or be pushed 10 feet away and knocked Prone. **Higher-Level Slots.** Extra damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 1.
